crossRefs.note: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred…
So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Mahanaim
people.line: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge

translations.web: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
translations.bsb: Barzillai was quite old, eighty years of age, and since he was a very wealthy man, he had provided for the king while he stayed in Mahanaim.
translations.kjv: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
translations.asv: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
